facts.fact: Medias241 reports the Libreville city hall's E-Tax platform, launched 12 June 2026, has enrolled nearly 2,000 market traders in 15 markets, records over 4,000 transactions and gives the city a register of active traders, with payments going directly to the municipal Treasury.

facts.fact: Medias241 reports mobile payments of market taxes in Libreville mobilised about FCFA 200 million through Airtel Money and FCFA 10 million through Moov, according to the E-Tax technical team.

Medias241 reports Libreville's city hall E-Tax lets market traders pay municipal taxes by web portal, app, mobile money or agent terminals, with over 4,000 transactions and about FCFA 210 million paid by mobile money since 12 June 2026; this is a municipal, not national, tax.

GAB.note: Municipal market taxes only; nothing on the national tax authority's filing or payment system.
